provenance: Reported by noahengelking in GitHub issue #2 (https://github.com/LuoStickmin/Nikon-Expeed-4-and-5-firmware-tool/issues/2) for D7500 C:1.10-1.12 after the repo's own K8 was recovered by an independent project.
verification: Generator-consistent: index 0x44 / step 0x3B reproduce this K8 from keys/t1.hex and raw D319A081BBF520EF, using the same convention that reproduces D850 (0x45/0xE3) and D3400 (0x39/0xB5). The header digest itself was NOT re-checked on this machine (no D7500 image); repack_firmware.py verifies the stock digest before use, so a wrong value fails closed with exit 3.
scope_note: Verifies the packaging-B header digest only. Not proof of image safety, provenance or authenticity, and not valid for any other model.

derivation.source: external report (issue #2); reproduced locally against keys/t1.hex
